column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-25 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. Phase 25 had no committed enumeration at all — the
# retired gate read a surface list out of an ignored generated root — so this file is the
# first authored opinion its gate is checked against.
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   items     the seeded mutant names the run read from the committed mutant domain
#   metrics   the metric keys in gen/dsl/phase25/phase-results.tsv
#   checks    the check ids tools/phase25_gate.py implements
# Every metric here is measured from evidence this run produced in its own bundle. The
# retired gate pinned the image index digest of a build that no longer exists and compared a
# committed ledger byte-for-byte, so it certified a past run rather than the one in progress.
# The four sprint receipts are now required to agree with *each other* on the index digest,
# which is a statement about this run's build and cannot be satisfied by a constant.
# The three ladder surfaces are the 2026-08-13 monocontainer amendment. They are the reason a
# rung choice is visible in a diff: `acquisition-rung-ladder` joins each baked binary to the
# rung an independently authored table says it belongs on, `last-resort-justification` requires
# every retained scavenge step to say why the rungs above it did not apply, and
# `rendered-from-set-bound` pins the rendered FROM set to the base plus exactly that recorded
# set — so a silent return to scavenging widens a set the gate is watching.
